tool_args.rationale: The initial short-horizon positive-gain observations leave genuine ambiguity about slow endogenous adaptation at the target forecast horizon. Acquire the slow-horizon discriminating probe before fitting.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit a dual-horizon or sink-coupled model using the five initial rows
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: All rows are short-horizon and have s_grad=0, so they cannot identify the slow adaptation scale or distinguish sink dependence; the target horizon is 21.9.
More short-horizon observations would not resolve long-horizon reversal.
It does not help identify the stated mechanisms and is not worth purchasing.
